pairs: nuntiatum est Joseph quod ægrotaret pater suus:
it was reported to Joseph that his father was sick.
And taking his two sons Manasseh
assumptis duobus filiis Manasse et Ephraim,
And it was told to the old man,
Ecce filius tuus Joseph venit ad te.
“Behold, your son Joseph is coming to you.”
And being strengthened, he sat up in bed.
And when he had entered to him,
Deus omnipotens apparuit mihi in Luza,
he said: “Almighty God appeared to me at Luz,
which is in the land of Canaan,
and I will make you influential among the people.
et faciam te in turbas populorum:
And I will give this land to you,
and to your offspring after you,
et semini tuo post te in possessionem sempiternam.
qui nati sunt tibi in terra Ægypti antequam huc venirem ad te,
who were born to you in the land of Egypt before I came here to you,
sicut Ruben et Simeon reputabuntur mihi.
Ephraim and Manasseh will be treated by me just like Reuben and Simeon.
Reliquos autem quos genueris post eos,
But the remainder, whom you will conceive after them,
et nomine fratrum suorum vocabuntur in possessionibus suis.
and they will be called by the name of their brothers among their possessions.
mortua est Rachel in terra Chanaan in ipso itinere,
Rachel died in the land of Canaan on the very journey,
et sepelivi eam juxta viam Ephratæ,
and buried her next to the way of Ephrath,
which by another name is called Bethlehem.”
Videns autem filios ejus dixit ad eum:
Then, seeing his sons, he said to him:
quos donavit mihi Deus in hoc loco.
whom God gave to me as a gift in this place.”
eos ad me, ut benedicam illis.
he said, “so that I may bless them.”
Oculi enim Israël caligabant præ nimia senectute,
For Israel’s eyes were clouded by reason of his great age,
and he was unable to see clearly.
And when they were placed up against him,
And he said to his son:
“I have not been cheated out of seeing you.
insuper ostendit mihi Deus semen tuum.
Moreover, God has shown me your offspring.”
Cumque tulisset eos Joseph de gremio patris,
And when Joseph had taken them from his father’s lap,
he reverenced prone on the ground.
Et posuit Ephraim ad dexteram suam,
And he placed Ephraim on his right, that is,
towards the left hand of Israel.
Yet truly Manasseh was on his left,
namely, towards his father’s right hand.
And he placed them both up against him.
And he, extending his right hand,
posuit super caput Ephraim minoris fratris:
placed it over the head of Ephraim, the younger brother,
sinistram autem super caput Manasse qui major natu erat,
but the left hand was on the head of Manasseh, who was the elder,
so that his hands were crossed.
And Jacob blessed the sons of Joseph,
in cujus conspectu ambulaverunt patres mei Abraham,
“God, in whose sight my fathers, Abraham and Isaac,
Deus qui pascit me ab adolescentia mea usque in præsentem diem:
God, who pastured me from my youth until the present day;
qui eruit me de cunctis malis,
who rescues me from all evils:
et invocetur super eos nomen meum,
And let my name be invoked over them,
and also the names of my fathers,
et crescant in multitudinem super terram.
And may they increase into a multitude across the earth.”
Videns autem Joseph quod posuisset pater suus dexteram manum super caput Ephraim,
But Joseph, seeing that his father had placed his right hand over the head of Ephraim,
et apprehensam manum patris levare conatus est de capite Ephraim, et transferre super caput Manasse.
And grasping his father’s hand, he tried to lift it from Ephraim’s head and transfer it onto the head of Manasseh.
And he said to his father:
“It should not have come to pass this way,
For this one is the firstborn.
pone dexteram tuam super caput ejus.
Place your right hand over his head.”
et iste quidem erit in populos,
will be among the people and will be multiplied.
But his younger brother will be greater than he.
et semen illius crescet in gentes.
And his offspring will increase among the nations.”
And he blessed them at that time, saying:
In te benedicetur Israël, atque dicetur:
Israel will be blessed, and it will be said:
And he established Ephraim before Manasseh.
Et ait ad Joseph filium suum:
And he said to his son Joseph:
and God will be with you,
reducetque vos ad terram patrum vestrorum.
and he will lead you back to the land of your fathers.
Do tibi partem unam extra fratres tuos,
I give you one part beyond that of your brothers,
quam tuli de manu Amorrhæi in gladio et arcu meo.
which I took from the hand of the Amorite with my sword and my bow.”
